With their truck gone, the team fights on - repossessing a van, facing a wild baker.
With Matt onboard, the team repos a rich kid's ride, an "Uncle Sam" vehicle, and battles rowdy rugby players.
Take a look inside the fast-paced, high pressure world of car repossession with highly trained professionals.
The confusion over Lou's new business relationship with Matt continues to mount.
The new truck arrives, fueling the growing feud between Team Lou and Team Matt.
After Froy's injury on a repo, tensions between Lou and Matt reach new heights.
Lou's new business relationship with Matt starts to unravel when a botched job puts a strain on the company.
Tensions between Lou and Matt continue to boil when Matt enlists his daughter's aid on another job.
A new rift between Matt and the rest of the crew puts the fate of the team in question.
